overview_description.description: Andalusia Egypt operates in the healthcare sector, providing a wide range of medical services across various specialties. Established in 1989, it has grown to include multiple clinics and hospitals, focusing on enhancing patient health and safety through the adoption of the latest medical technologies. Its facilities offer comprehensive healthcare services, including internal medicine and numerous other medical specialties, aiming to deliver quality care. Andalusia Egypt employs a team of highly skilled doctors and healthcare professionals dedicated to improving patient outcomes.
